headline: Ross Smith beats Anderson 8-2 to win the Hungarian Darts Trophy
standfirst: Ross Smith won European Tour 11 in Budapest, averaging 101.01 in an 8-2 final win over Gary Anderson.
body: Ross Smith won the Hungarian Darts Trophy at the MVM Dome in Budapest, beating Gary Anderson 8-2 in the final. Smith averaged 101.01 to Anderson's 90.50.
Smith started strongly with a 101.33 average against William O'Connor in the last 32. He then beat Jonny Clayton 6-4, Dave Chisnall 6-2 and Danny Noppert 7-3 to reach the final.

Anderson came through two deciding-leg matches. He beat Gian van Veen 6-5 in the quarter-finals, averaging 101.45, and then edged Nathan Aspinall 7-6 in the semi-finals despite Aspinall averaging 96.87. Earlier, Anderson's 105.27 against Krzysztof Ratajski was the best average of the tournament.
Beau Greaves averaged 104.88 in her first-round match against Rob Cross, who hit a 170 checkout in the same game. Chris Dobey also hit a 170, against Josh Rock.
Anderson hit 23 maximums, the most at the event, with Smith and Aspinall on 16 each.
